newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Koipe 9-mth net narrows [CORRECTED 18:55 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Spain's Koipe 9-mth net narrows [CORRECTED 18:55 GMT].

text.p: Results for Koipe S.A. in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
(Corrects third line to read Gross income rather than Net taxed)

NOTE - Koipe said results were not comparable with the prior year's because of its sale of interests in non-strategic businesses. It also said net income in the prior year included extraordinary items.

Koipe said the results were satisfactory, given these issues and the difficult period for the olive oil industry, and said they represented an excellent base for the expected recovery in olive oil consumption after the decline in prices expected ahead of the magnificent 1996/97 harvest.
